children: Paul Glavine disclosed a 5.8% beneficial stake in Cybin Inc. through a Schedule 13D filing. The filing on September 9, 2026 follows his August 31 open‑market purchase of 90,000 shares and a September 1 grant of 1,046,899 restricted stock units. The move concentrates ownership between his direct holdings and shares and warrants held via PLG Family Trust.

Glavine reports that he holds Cybin shares for investment purposes and through issuer employee incentive awards. He states no specific plans for changes at the company and highlights ownership split between directly held shares and positions held through PLG Family Trust.

Paul Glavine is a Canadian entrepreneur and the Co‑Founder and Chief Growth Officer of Cybin Inc. He also serves as a trustee of the PLG Family Trust, which holds additional Cybin securities. Glavine focuses on building and investing in psychedelic‑assisted therapy platforms and related life‑sciences ventures.
